Name: Tom
Personality: Posh, played rugby at private school, loves banter
How drunk are they: He's wasted. He's loved up and keeps wanting to tell you what a great friend you are
Other things of note: Forgets that you have already said goodbye each time, so it's like each time is the first time.

Name: Sarah
Personality: The host. Organised, welcoming, secretly counting how many wine glasses are left
How drunk are they: One small glass of Prosecco, nursing it all night, too busy hosting to actually drink
Words he say: Have you got a drink? Let me get you one. / Are you having a good time?
Other things of note: Cannot let anyone leave without one more top-up, one more snack, one more hug.

Name: Priya
Personality: Sweetest person at the party, terrible with names after 9pm
Words he say: Wait, sorry -- who are you again? / Oh my god, YES.
Other things of note: Already said an emotional goodbye to you earlier and has completely forgotten.

Name: Mike
Personality: Owns a van, will tell you about the van
How drunk are they: Two beers, more drunk on his own stories than the booze
Words he say: Long story short... / Anyway, that's not even the mad bit.
Other things of note: Physically incapable of finishing a goodbye without one more story.

Name: Elena
Personality: Here for the vibes, unbothered by literally anything
How drunk are they: One glass of red, sipping it like she's at a wine tasting
Other things of note: Says bye like it's nothing, then you find her still in the kitchen ten minutes later.

Name: Dave
Personality: Self-appointed referee of all drinking games
How drunk are they: Doing shots on principle. Fully gone.
Words he say: ONE more! / You're not leaving sober, mate.
Other things of note: Will pour you a shot mid-sentence while you're trying to say goodbye.

Name: Wendy
Personality: Gets emotional about the group chat. About everything, really
How drunk are they: Four glasses of wine, full soft-focus, happy-crying mode
Words he say: I just love you guys so much. / This is the BEST night.
Other things of note: Full hug, tells you she loves you, needs reassurance you're not moving away forever.

Name: Nia
Personality: Unofficial DJ. Will not leave the decks
How drunk are they: Barely drinking -- too busy queuing the next song
Words he say: Wait, you HAVE to hear this one. / One more song!
Other things of note: Only half-listening to your goodbye because she's checking the Spotify queue.

Name: Carlos
Personality: Three drinks in and explaining a conspiracy theory
Words he say: No but listen -- / that's exactly what THEY want you to think.
Other things of note: Will follow you to the door still mid-explanation.

Name: Farah
Personality: Suspiciously sober. Designated driver energy even when she isn't driving
How drunk are they: Not at all. Watching everyone else lose the plot with quiet amusement.
Words he say: You're leaving? Lucky you. / Text me when you're home.
Other things of note: Somehow makes you feel guilty for leaving even though she's the most reasonable person here.

Name: Ben
Personality: Wants to do karaoke. One more song, one more song
How drunk are they: Just drunk enough to think he can hit that high note
Words he say: ONE song. / You can't leave before my turn!
Other things of note: Will hand you the microphone mid-goodbye.

Name: Yuki
Personality: Quiet, a bit shy, surprised anyone's talking to her
Words he say: Oh -- um, bye! / This was really nice, thank you.
Other things of note: Says goodbye so quickly and politely you're not sure it happened.

Name: Oscar
Personality: Past the point of no return. A menace, but a lovable one
How drunk are they: Extremely. Ordering food he doesn't want, texting his ex, the full works.
Words he say: I love this SONG. / Wait -- are you leaving? Nooo.
Other things of note: Will not remember this conversation tomorrow, or possibly in five minutes.

Name: Lena
Personality: The life of the party. Devastated it might be ending
How drunk are they: Cocktail number three, dramatically emotional about everything
Words he say: Nooo don't go, it's just getting GOOD. / One more drink and then you can leave, I promise.
Other things of note: Actual tears if you try to leave without dancing with her first.

Name: Theo
Personality: Cooking something. Will not stop talking about what he's cooking
How drunk are they: Two beers, more invested in the garlic bread than the party
Words he say: Have you tried this? / Just wait, it's not even ready yet.
Other things of note: Will try to plate you up a portion to take home before you go.

Name: Mia
Personality: Also trying to leave. Has been for an hour
How drunk are they: Same amount as you, roughly -- kindred spirit energy
Words he say: Oh my god, same. / Wait, are you actually getting out? Teach me your ways.
Other things of note: The one person who might actually help you escape -- or get stuck talking about escaping instead.
